results.title: Chhatron Ki Goonj Event Indore: Women In Viral Dance Video Were Professional Performers, Not Students, Says Congress Spokesperson | VIDEO
results.description: A viral dance video linked to Rahul Gandhi’s Chhatron Ki Goonj event in Indore triggered social media debate. Congress spokesperson Amit Chaurasia clarified that the dancers were professional performers, not students, and the performance was part of a promotional activity. The party said the youth-focused event aims to address education, employment and student-related concerns.
